    (hs : SupportedGauge a b (qLength coord) U.carrier f) {z : Point} (hz : z.2.1 ∈ U.carrier)

      (streamPotential d a b M (qLength coord) v f) z =
        f z - compactAlias d a b M (qLength coord) v (PressureStream.weightedSource f) z / z.1
